about_the_game:
"Awaken amidst the shattered remnants of the Forgotten Lands --- inscribe your laws of survival with magic. Each cycle weaves a new symphony of power."​

Magic-themed Action RPG | Development Purpose: Unreal Engine learning project for me.

Premise

A dimensional rift consumed your memories, leaving you stranded in the Mystic Wastes - a cursed expanse teeming with spectral horrors. As celestial anomalies bind time in endless loops, forge your path through cycles of combat against Realmkeepers. Unearth arcane secrets scattered across this ever-resetting continent...

Core Gameplay Loop​

  • ​​Roguelite Progression:​​ Battle through ​​multiple procedurally generated maps​​, defeating enemies to ​​gain EXP and coins​​.

  • ​​Meta Progression:​​ Use coins ​​between runs​​ to permanently upgrade stats, unlocking ​​new zones or higher difficulties​​.

  • ​​Time-Loop Mechanic:​​ Each reset ("cycle") reshapes the world, offering fresh challenges.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

  • OS: Windows 10

  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 3080
